newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Exports of Philippine economic zones up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Exports of Philippine economic zones up in 1996.

text.p: Export receipts in the export-processing economic zones in the Philippines totalled $6.5 billion last year, up 52 percent from $4.284 billion registered the previous year, the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) said on Friday.
The $6.5 billion in exports was also higher than the $5.025 billion targetted for the year.
Exports from the northern Baguio city economic zone led the pack with export receipts reaching $1.199 billion. It was followed by the Cavite economic zone, with $1.138 billion in exports.
Exporters located inside the zones are exempted from income tax and are accorded preferential tariff rates for their raw materials.
There are 49 export-processing economic zones in the Philippines.
